title: 10-Day Greece Tour: Athens, Santorini & Crete
metaDescription: Discover Athens, Santorini and Crete in 10 days, combining ancient landmarks, volcanic scenery and the history, landscapes and traditions of Crete.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
Greece Tours & Packages 2026–2027 | Private & Island Hopping
summary:
The 10-Day Greece Tour connects Athens with Santorini, Rhodes and Crete, giving each stop a different role in the journey. Begin with the Acropolis and historic center of Athens before continuing to Santorini for its volcanic caldera and Cycladic villages. Rhodes introduces the fortified Medieval City and a different chapter of Greek history, while Crete completes the route with its deeper local traditions, varied landscapes and distinctive island culture.
Planned between April and October around seasonal connections, the trip uses a combination of domestic flights and ferry travel. Selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, airport and port transfers, and scheduled sightseeing are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half day Morning Athens City tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a half-day guided tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Acropolis Museum, and Parthenon. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Afternoon at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Santorini.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free day in Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Free day in Santorini.
Enjoy the island’s famous black sand beaches, stunning views, and romantic sunsets.
Visit Fira and explore its whitewashed houses, narrow streets, and cliffside cafes.
Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Heraklion (Crete)
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel.
Free time at leisure until transfer to the port for your high-speed ferry to Heraklion.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Heraklion.

itinerary.title: Heraklion at leisure
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a free day in Heraklion, the capital of Crete. We recommend visiting the famous Palace of Knossos and the Heraklion Archaeological Museum. You may also explore the city’s local cafés, shops, and seaside promenade. Overnight in Heraklion.

itinerary.title: Flight to Rhodes
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel.
Free time at leisure until transfer to the airport for your domestic flight to Rhodes.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Rhodes.

itinerary.title: Day at leisure in Rhodes
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a free day in Rhodes to explore the Medieval Old Town or visit the impressive Acropolis of Lindos. Relax on the island’s beautiful beaches or enjoy local cafés, shops, and seaside restaurants. In the evening, experience traditional Greek cuisine at a local tavern. Overnight in Rhodes.

itinerary.title: Flight to Athens
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel.
Free time at leisure until transfer to the airport for your domestic flight to Athens.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Athens Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 10-Day Best Greece Tour?
faqs.a: The 10-Day Best Greece Tour covers Athens, Rhodes, Crete, and Santorini. You will explore Athens' ancient landmarks, discover the medieval charm of Rhodes, experience the rich history and culture of Crete, and enjoy Santorini's spectacular caldera views and world-famous sunsets. The tour runs for 9 nights and 10 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 10-Day Best Greece Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,295 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, speed ferry tickets, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers specified in the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights and ferry tickets included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights and all required speed ferry tickets between destinations. These transportation arrangements allow you to travel efficiently while enjoying Greece's beautiful islands and coastal scenery.

faqs.q: Are international flights included in the package?
faqs.a: No, international flights are not included in the tour price. Travelers are responsible for arranging their own flights to and from Greece. Magnificent Travel can assist with travel planning and recommendations if needed.

faqs.q: Does the 10-day Greece tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while helping you discover Greece's most famous destinations.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors seeking a comprehensive Greek experience. It combines ancient history, medieval architecture, island culture, beautiful beaches, and breathtaking scenery, offering an excellent introduction to Greece.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic towns, ferry ports, and island villages. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate throughout the itinerary.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Rhodes, Crete, and Santorini?
faqs.a: Rhodes is famous for its UNESCO-listed Medieval Old Town, Palace of the Grand Master, and beautiful beaches. Crete offers impressive archaeological sites, traditional villages, and stunning landscapes. Santorini is renowned for its caldera views, whitewashed villages, blue-domed churches, and unforgettable sunsets.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 10-Day Best Greece Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, transportation conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 10-Day Best Greece Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The tour operates throughout the year, subject to seasonal ferry schedules and flight availability. You can extend your stay in Athens, Rhodes, Crete, or Santorini, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary according to your preferences. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
